websiteNote: From 5 pages of their campaign website, including its issues section.

Jobs and the economy.summary: Says that as lieutenant governor they worked to grow jobs by seeking economic development.
Jobs and the economy.quote: From 2015-2023, he served as the state’s 20th lieutenant and focused on growing jobs through aggressively pursuing economic development, more parental choice in education and boldly reforming state government.

Taxes and spending.summary: Says that in Congress they pushed for changes to taxes and entitlement programs to grow jobs and lower the national debt.
Taxes and spending.quote: In Congress, he advocated for bold tax reform and entitlement reform to grow jobs and reduce the national debt.
